sections.name: General Awareness and General Knowledge (including WB Special)

subjects.name: General Awareness, General Knowledge & West Bengal Special (সাধারণ জ্ঞান, সমসাময়িক বিষয় ও পশ্চিমবঙ্গ বিশেষ)
domains: History of Bengal & National Movement: Battle of Plassey (1757), Battle of Buxar (1764), Bengal Renaissance (Raja Ram Mohan Roy, Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar, Swami Vivekananda, Rabindranath Tagore, Kazi Nazrul Islam)

Revolutionary Freedom Struggle: Anushilan Samiti, Jugantar, Khudiram Bose, Prafulla Chaki, Surya Sen (Chittagong Armoury Raid 1930), Matangini Hazra (Tamralipta Jatiya Sarkar), Subhash Chandra Bose & INA
Geography of West Bengal: Physiography (Darjeeling Himalayan region, Sandakphu 3636m - highest peak, Buxa-Duars, Rarh plain, Coastal Sundarbans Delta - UNESCO World Heritage Site & Biosphere Reserve)
River Systems & Climate: Ganga / Bhagirathi-Hooghly, Teesta, Torsa, Jaldhaka, Mahananda, Damodar ('Sorrow of Bengal'), Rupnarayan, Subarnarekha; Kalbaishakhi (Nor'wester)
Districts & Administration: 23 Districts of West Bengal, 5 Administrative Divisions (Jalpaiguri, Malda, Burdwan, Presidency, Medinipur), Kolkata Police (CP Kolkata) and West Bengal Police (DGP WB)
West Bengal Wildlife & Protected Areas: Sundarbans National Park, Jaldapara (One-horned Rhinoceros), Gorumara, Buxa Tiger Reserve, Neora Valley, Singalila National Park

Indian Constitution & Governance: Preamble, Fundamental Rights, Directive Principles, President, Governor, Chief Minister, West Bengal Legislative Assembly (294 seats), Calcutta High Court (Oldest High Court in India - 1862)

General Science & Everyday Technology: Physics (Mechanics, Sound, Optics, Electricity), Chemistry (Acids, Bases, Metals, Polymers), Biology (Human Physiology, Nutrition, Vitamins, Infectious Diseases), Environmental Science

Police Administration & State Schemes: WBP Motto, Police Ranks (DGP, ADG, DIG, SP, SDPO, Inspector, SI, ASI, Constable), Traffic rules, Dial 112, Kanyashree Prakalpa, Lakshmir Bhandar, Swasthya Sathi, Sabooj Sathi

subjects.name: English Language, Grammar, Comprehension & Vocabulary (ইংরেজি ব্যাকরণ ও শব্দভাণ্ডার)
domains: Grammar Fundamentals: Parts of Speech (Noun, Pronoun, Verb, Adjective, Adverb, Preposition, Conjunction, Interjection), Subject-Verb Agreement / Concord
Tenses & Time: Simple, Continuous, Perfect, Perfect Continuous tenses across Present, Past, and Future
Articles & Determiners: Use of Definite (The) and Indefinite (A, An) articles, Quantifiers (some, any, few, little)
Prepositions & Phrasal Verbs: Fixed prepositions (abstain from, capable of, listen to), Prepositions of time and place, Common phrasal verbs (look into, call off, give up, break down)
Voice Change & Narration: Active to Passive Voice and Passive to Active Voice; Direct to Indirect Speech (Statements, Questions, Imperatives, Exclamatory)
Sentence Transformation & Correction: Simple, Complex, and Compound sentences; Degree of Comparison (Positive, Comparative, Superlative); Spotting Errors in sentences
Vocabulary & Word Power: Synonyms, Antonyms, Homonyms and Homophones, One-word Substitutions (Philanthropist, Ominous, Omnipotent, Polyglot)
Idioms & Phrases: Common English idioms and their meanings ('Bite the bullet', 'Once in a blue moon', 'A feather in one's cap', 'Burn the midnight oil')
Spelling Test: Commonly misspelled words (Accommodate, Bureaucracy, Maintenance, Privilege, Separate, Queue)

subjects.name: Elementary Mathematics - Madhyamik Standard (প্রাথমিক পাটিগণিত ও বীজগণিত - মাধ্যমিক মান)
domains: Number System & Basic Arithmetic: Natural numbers, Integers, Prime numbers, Divisibility rules (2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 11), Place value and Face value
LCM and HCF: HCF and LCM of integers and fractions, Relation between HCF, LCM and product of numbers, Word problems
Fractions, Decimals & Simplification: Vulgar fractions, Recurring decimals, BODMAS / VBODMAS rule, Square roots and Cube roots
Ratio, Proportion & Partnership: Direct and Inverse proportion, Third and Fourth proportional, Mean proportional, Business partnership and profit distribution
Average & Problems on Ages: Simple average, Weighted average, Consecutive numbers average, Linear age equations
Percentage & Applications: Percentage calculation, Increase/decrease percentage, Population and depreciation problems, Examination marks
Profit, Loss & Discount: Cost price, Selling price, Marked price, Profit%, Loss%, Successive discounts, False weight / dishonest trader problems
Simple & Compound Interest: Simple interest formula (PTR/100), Compound interest annual and semi-annual, Difference between CI and SI for 2 and 3 years
Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns: Individual and joint work, Work and wages, Efficiency ratios, Tank filling and emptying problems
Speed, Time & Distance: Speed conversion (km/h to m/s), Relative speed (same and opposite direction), Train crossing pole, platform and another train, Boats and streams
Mensuration (Madhyamik Standard): Perimeter and Area of triangle, rectangle, square, circle, semi-circle; Surface area and Volume of cuboid, cube, cylinder

subjects.name: Reasoning and Logical Analysis (যুক্তি ও বিশ্লেষণমূলক ক্ষমতা)
domains: Number & Alphabet Series: Arithmetic series, Geometric series, Alternate series, Two-tier difference series, Missing number puzzles
Analogy & Classification: Word analogies (Country-Capital, State-River, Instrument-Measurement), Number analogies, Alphabet analogies, Odd one out (Words, Numbers, Letters)
Coding & Decoding: Letter shifting (+1, +2, +3, reverse), Substitution coding, Mixed letter-number coding, Deciphering message codes
Direction & Distance Sense: Four cardinal and four intercardinal directions, Left/right turns, Clockwise/counter-clockwise angular turns, Pythagoras theorem straight-line distance
Blood Relations: Decoded relationships, Family tree diagrams, Pointing to a photograph / person statements
Clock & Calendar: Angle between hour and minute hands, Coincidence and right-angle frequencies, Day of week calculation, Leap years, Odd days
Order & Ranking, Seating Arrangement: Position from left/right, Total persons in a row, Linear single-row seating, Circular seating facing center
Venn Diagrams & Syllogism: Three-circle Venn diagrams, Syllogistic deductions (All, Some, No statements), Validity of conclusions
Mathematical Operations: Arithmetic symbol substitution (+, -, *, /), Balancing equations, Inequality statements (>, <, =)
Visual & Spatial Non-Verbal Reasoning: Mirror images, Water images, Paper folding and cutting, Embedded figures, Pattern completion, Dice and Cube faces
